verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio is a no-code drag-and-drop builder for verification workflows, and webhooks let external systems be notified/act on workflow status changes, together enabling rule-like, event-triggered automation (docs-1, docs-32, docs-4, docs-5). However, the docs don't detail conditional/branching rule logic (if/then triggers) beyond generic flow-chart building, and there's no independent corroboration of complex rule automation. Missing for 10: explicit conditional rule/branching documentation, independent hands-on validation of automation depth.
